title: fix(pm): advisory_read holds its sender to target-write, by the maintainer's ruling
body:
Fixes #29644
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:中继的密封公告读取操作(`advisory_read`)现在只要求发送者对目标仓有写、维护或管理权限,与其余中继操作同一道门;不再要求发送者在该公告的协作者名单上。原「协作者」档位整个删除,任何其他取值仍一律拒绝、不封装任何内容。
- 为什么改:按维护者裁决「同意改成对仓库有写权限,立卡派发修复」。旧门槛让首批三次真实读取全部被拒,而有写权限的账号本可自行加为协作者,旧门槛并未挡住任何人。
- 风险与回滚:读取令牌仍只铸「只读」公告权限,未提升;改动只落在中继 `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` 三个文件,不进任何发布包;回滚即还原这一个 commit。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`(`advisory_read` 行的 `senderGate` 与 `sender` 关卡,风险最高);`execute.mjs`(`advisory_read` 自测电池中的发送者用例);`validate.mjs`(关卡用例)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`,预期末行以 `✓ fleet-write/execute self-test: 260 cases pass across 22 batteries` 开头。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `advisory_read`'s `senderGate` is `'target-write'` (was `'collaborator'`). A read is held to the gate every relay stroke already passes, write, maintain or admin on the target, which the executor judges on the stroke before the advisory's GET. The maintainer's ruling is quoted verbatim in the `ops.mjs` header paragraph and in the row comment, replacing the text that called `collaborator` "the card's recommendation" and said the maintainer would rule on the pull request.
- The row's `grant` stays `read`. The row comment says a read refused under it is the maintainer's to rule on, never a raise to write.
- **The `collaborator` arm is removed, not kept.** It measured as refusing every live read, it excluded no one (a write sender can add itself to an advisory), and nothing outside these three files names it, so under the startup-stage rule it retires instead of staying a tested but unused setting. `ADVISORY_READ_SENDER_GATES` keeps the one value, and any other value, `collaborator` included, fails closed with nothing sealed.
- Follow-on inside the same files: the `sender` fence no longer reads the sender, so `advisoryReadFenceFailures`' context drops `sender` and `advisoryReadAction` no longer takes it. No exported symbol is renamed or removed.
- `dispatch.mjs` is unchanged. None of its cases pins the gate: its end-to-end read's sender is on the fixture's collaborators, so it passes under either gate.

## A hypothesis, not a finding

These are the readings from the session that led to the ruling (run ids only). The add's PATCH answer listed the sender (run 41545025429). Three reads after it were refused at fence `sender` (runs 41545143476, 41545259848, 41546082963). A re-sent add's pre-PATCH GET under the write grant already listed the sender, so it was a no-op (run 41546190167).

**That the read-grant GET answer omits `collaborating_users` is a hypothesis. It is UNVERIFIED.** This PR does not depend on it and does not prove it, and nothing here measured it. The `ops.mjs` header says the same.

## Tests

- **Executor (`execute.mjs`), `advisory_read` battery, 17 to 18 cases:**
  - Rewritten: a sender with write on the target who is not on the advisory's `collaborating_users` is now sealed for, and the parts open byte for byte for the seat's key. Before, this case pinned a refusal.
  - New: a sender with triage on the target is refused before the advisory's GET, even when the advisory lists it as a collaborator. Exit 4, only the permission read is sent, and there is no row, no seal and no part.
  - Rewritten: a made-up gate and the retired `collaborator` both fail closed after the GET, even for a write sender the advisory lists.
  - The marker sweep now covers 20 runs (was 19), with the battery name, the roster pin and the verdict line updated to match.
- **Validator (`validate.mjs`), `advisory_read` battery, 28 cases (count unchanged):**
  - The row pin is now one setting, `target-write`, with the grant `read`.
  - `target-write` reads no collaborator: someone else listed, none, null or a team alone are all accepted.
  - Any other gate fails closed: the retired value, misspellings, a prototype key, empty, or absent.
  - The fence-read case now refuses at `sender` only under an unknown gate.
  - The leak case now feeds a prose gate value and asserts it is never echoed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's third acceptance item is the seat's to do after merge:** one live `advisory_read` by a seat with write on the target that opens, recorded on the card as a run id. It is not done here.
- `ops.mjs` has no `--self-test` of its own. Run with the flag, it exits 0 and prints nothing, because it is only an import. Its table is pinned by `validate.mjs --self-test`.
- **No changeset:** `scripts/pm/` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- `origin/main` moved two commits past base `3482f3d8`. Neither touches `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` or its imports, so nothing was merged in.
